alpha.description: Draw multiplier 0..1, not native reverse-alpha byte. Material/library renderers multiply their explicit opacity once. shape owns opacityStart/End instead and forbids alpha. Dust/light/sound omit this field. Additive blend keeps scaled RGB with zero vertex alpha.

anchor.description: Primitive/cue/event placement: self/field=bound entity center; owner=active owner center; tip/tipHistory=projectile geometric tip (item uses engine itemLocation); velocity=center with motion axis; hitPoint=captured event point, NPC center for item hit/crit. Item hitPoint without a captured point is silent. Projectile event anchors and sprite pose are frozen at emission and carried through the relay, including after source removal; unavailable owner is silent. History renderers use their named center/tip histories instead of relocating the path.

color.description: Explicit local RGB bytes; no named colors, global color references or alpha. White preserves texture RGB; opacity is separate.

duration.description: Individual detached lifetime in world ticks: shape 1..120, other duration-owning renderers 3..120. shape uses explicit lifetime endpoints without extra fade; spriteElement uses opacityProfile; libraryParticle uses endOpacity. Live path/history owns its own lifetime and omits duration.

dust.description: Explicit emission into Terraria native Dust, not a custom particle simulation. The selected native type owns subsequent animation, motion, tint and lifetime. Count, size, initial velocity, native alpha and gravity flag are independent. directionFrame selects world +X or captured source forward; angleOffsetRadians offsets the cone center. Angular distribution random samples uniformly; even spans partial-cone endpoints, or divides a full circle without duplicating its endpoint. Even distribution with count one uses the cone center. Speed is uniform between speedMinPxPerTick and speedMaxPxPerTick; source velocity is multiplied only by inheritVelocity. Identical emission math for item and projectile. Zero count or size emits nothing. Native alpha is Terraria's 0..255 parameter, not an opacity multiplier. No inferred Smoke gravity or inherited velocity.

angleOffsetRadians.description: Cone center offset from world +X or captured source forward.

count.description: Integer emissions before shared/client budgets; zero is silent.

inheritVelocity.description: Explicit source-velocity multiplier added to initial velocity.

nativeAlpha.description: Terraria Dust alpha byte, not opacity; native type controls its use.

noGravity.description: Exact native Dust noGravity flag; never inferred from type.

size.description: Native Dust size multiplier, independent of velocity/count; zero is silent.

spawn.description: Uniform birth positions around the existing emission origin, sampled once per particle. point has no extra controls; line/rectangle are centered, with world +X or source-forward frame and an explicit rotation. annulus samples uniformly by area; inner radius zero gives a disk, equal radii a ring. Zero extents remain literal. Existing element offsets add once. Source-attached elements capture sampled offsets locally and then follow the source, without resampling. Position sampling has a separate deterministic seed stream and does not change velocity sampling.

All textures have opaque alpha. Glow/flare black RGB contributes zero in additive; alpha blend visibly includes the black rectangle. Additive overlap sums light and can saturate tinted colors toward white; coincident particles increase energy, not separation. spawn controls initial positions; spreadRadians controls velocity directions. Both blends are literal choices, never auto-converted. Dimensions are authored world pixels, not native texture dimensions.
